text:
ana: Quick green-room contingency check for Thursday's webinar — can we run a micro-sim of demo failover paths today at 10:30 PT? Need to validate model fallback, lead-tagging, and OBS scene switches.

mike: I can spin up the demo harness and inject synthetic traffic. estimated ~20m. want me to use staging or a fresh env? :clock10: 

zara: staging is fine but i'll deploy the canary model variants first. if main 13B OOMs, plan to fallback to the 6B quantized. do we have a metric threshold to trigger autoswitch?

sam: threshold = p99 latency > 1200ms for 3 consecutive mins OR oom/error rate > 5% in 1m window. when fallback happens, we should tag leads with "demo_fallback" and route to SRE queue.

leo: +1 to tagging. also want to validate our routing header so Marketo mapping keeps the session id. will test inbound webhook mapping.

ana (small typo fix): *ana: typo — that's me :)*

mike: ok deploying canary to staging now. devops-bot will confirm.

devops-bot: deploy-bot: canary/model-redwood-13b -> staging started (id: canary-202403). watching logs.

mike: canary deployed. running traffic script with 200 rps for 2m then spike to 800 rps for failover sim.

zara: pushing fallback image model-redwood-6b-4bit to staging as standby.

sam: test plan for lead tagging: run a synthetic request that triggers fallback and then check the inbound webhook payload for tags. sample curl to run: 

curl -X POST https://staging-demo.redwood/infer \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"prompt":"Test fallback path","session_id":"webinar-smoke-1","email":"test+webinar@example.com"}'

leo: i'll monitor the Marketo side. expected payload keys: session_id, user_email, tags[]. Confirming mapping: tags -> custom_field_webinar_tags.

zara: quick routing snippet we'll use in the harness config (copy/paste):

```
routing:
  - match: /infer
    primary: model-redwood-13b
    fallback: model-redwood-6b-4bit
    conditions:
      - p99_latency_ms > 1200
      - error_rate_pct > 5
    webhook_tag: webinar_fallback
```

ana: can we also exercise OBS scene change? if fallback happens mid-demo we want to switch to the "minimal demo" scene and show a banner. mike can you wire the event?

mike: yep. will emit a short webhook to obs-control: POST /scene with body {"scene":"minimal-demo","reason":"fallback"}.

devops-bot: smoke-run: traffic script started.

mike: smoke-run done. triggered fallback at ~45s of the spike. confirmed inbound webhook payload had tags: ["webinar","demo_fallback"], session_id preserved. Leo pls confirm Marketo side.

leo: confirmed. lead arrived in Marketo with tags mapped to custom_field_webinar_tags. forwarded to SDR queue with tag "webinar-fallback". :white_check_mark:

zara: logs look clean. no data leakage. latency after fallback stable ~220ms per token on 6B.

sam: record this as a run-of-show contingency note: "If fallback triggers, notify stage ops, switch OBS to minimal-demo, tag leads with demo_fallback, route to SDR-fallback queue."

ana: thanks team — can we schedule a 10m quick rehearsal tomorrow morning to run this end-to-end with the speakers on mute? propose 9:30 PT.

mike: works for me.

zara: works.

leo: ok. i'll be on for Marketo checks.

devops-bot: calendar-bot: event created "Webinar contingency micro-rehearsal" 2024-04-03 09:30 PT. invites sent to participants.

ana: perfect. final ask — add a 1-slide callout in the speaker deck that says "We may route to a lower-latency demo model during scale tests; behavior is expected." simple is good.

sam: adding slide now. will push to shared drive.

ana: awesome. closing thread. :sparkles:
